correctness.rationale: Every ternary cubic is uniquely normalized in (5^10-1)/4=2,441,406 scalar classes; exhaustive rational tangency masks over all 31 PG(2,5) points show no nonsingular-at-rational-points form exceeds 29 covered points. This supersample includes all geometrically smooth forms. The two displayed smooth representative cubics have 8 and 10 rational points, each with 29-point tangent union; independent direct F5 point/gradient evaluation reproduced both omitted-point pairs. Exact PGL3(F5) orbit enumeration of 93,000 forms per representative exhausts the 186,000 extremizers; geometric smoothness is certified by the full-chart unit Gröbner ideals. Distinct point counts give distinct Frobenius traces -2 and -4 and hence zeta numerators 1+2T+5T² and 1+4T+5T². Reconstructed source checker loops and orbit method were inspected, but the complete 2.44-million-form C++ orbit execution was not rerun in this audit; independent checks corroborate representatives, not full exhaustion.
